clips.title: EVA
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, far-future setting, awe-and-peril space opera grade. The outer hull of a station orbiting a blue supergiant star, endless white panels curving away, antenna arrays, the star's corona flaring beyond the horizon line of the hull. A person in a sleek white EVA suit with an illuminated visor pulls themselves hand over hand along a rail, tether trailing, pausing as a solar flare erupts silently across the whole sky and washes the hull in light. Ice crystals sparkle off the suit, a distant shuttle glints. Blinding star key with deep space shadow. Camera floating alongside, slow drift, 40mm. Visor reflections, lens flare, 24fps.

clips.title: Cantina Docks
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, far-future setting, lived-in space opera grade. A crowded spaceport promenade at night cycle, stacked neon signage in alien scripts, steam vents, cargo loaders hauling crates past ship berths where battered freighters stand on landing struts. A person in a worn flight jacket, utility harness and boots strides through the crowd with a duffel over one shoulder, weaving between vendors and dock workers toward a freighter's lowered ramp. Sparks rain from a welder overhead, a droid trundles past, landing lights strobe. Mixed neon and sodium work lights with haze. Steadicam following through the crowd, 28mm. Shallow depth of field, atmospheric haze, 24fps.

clips.title: The Last Broadcast
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, far-future setting, solemn space opera grade. A ruined communications deck on a drifting derelict ship, sparking cables hanging, frost on every surface, a single working console casting green light, the viewport showing a shattered moon outside. A person in a patched officer's coat with frost on the shoulders braces over the console, keys in a final transmission, and slowly straightens to watch the signal indicator pulse out into the dark. Floating dust motes, a flickering emergency strip, breath fogging. Green console key against frozen blue dark. Slow orbit around the console to their profile, 40mm anamorphic. Deep shadow, subtle grain, 24fps.
